data.body: Implemented: disk_pressure_prunes counter added to observability.sh via publish_autodeploy_marker_delta with a record-anchored ERE ('^AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE \{') and its own DISK_PRESSURE_OFFSET_FILE; new tests/scripts/test_observability_disk_pressure.py drives the real script over a synthetic journal (anchored-count, cold-start seed-to-0, second-run delta); runbook note added distinguishing gate-did-not-run from gate-ran-and-reclaimed-nothing.
